waypoints.name: Lupine Meadows Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Moose Junction on US-26/89/191, turn west onto the Teton Park Road, pass the Moose entrance station, and drive north a little over 7 miles to the Lupine Meadows Road on the left, just south of Jenny Lake. Follow the gravel road to its end at the Lupine Meadows parking area. A Grand Teton National Park entrance pass is required.

waypoints.name: Grand Teton
waypoints.directions: Hike the Lupine Meadows trail south and up the switchbacks, keeping left into Garnet Canyon at the Amphitheater Lake junction, and follow the canyon trail and boulder field to the Meadows. Climb the Middle Fork past the moraine and up the fixed-line headwall to the Lower Saddle, then ascend to the Upper Saddle and follow the Owen-Spalding route (Belly Roll, Crawl, chimneys) to the summit.
